label: Synthetic practice market B (12 tickers, 6 sectors)
notice: Synthetic example prices generated by a computer program. Not real market data, not live quotes, and not any real company.

generator.method: Daily random walk in integer cents with an opening gap; each day's move mixes a shared sector shock (correlation 0.6) with the symbol's own noise.

events.description: A scripted fictional earnings surprise: the stock opens well above the previous close.
A scripted market-wide decline: every symbol drifts lower for 20 simulated days.
